How to apply for an Electronic Travel Authorization (ETA) for Sri Lanka If you’re heading to Sri Lanka for up to 30 days, you can obtain an e-visa (officially, an Electronic Travel Authorization or ETA) from the government’s Department of Immigration and Emigration website.
